name: cleanloop
description: CleanLoop: sort, collect, report, predict and recycle household waste. Built on AWS for Environmental Hacks 2026.

scripts.build: npm run build:lambdas && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:dynamo: docker run -d --rm --name cleanloop-ddb -p 8000:8000 amazon/dynamodb-local >/dev/null && sleep 3; DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 npm test -w backend; s=$?; docker stop cleanloop-ddb >/dev/null; exit $s
